definitions.explanation: The system that provides water to buildings, or the water from it.
The fixture from which water flows.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{水道|すいどう} combines {水|すい} (water) + {道|どう} (way/path), literally "water way."

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{水道水|すいどうすい}→水道水：25349_suidousui⟧: tap water
- ⟦{水道代|すいどうだい}→水道代：09544_suidoudai⟧: water bill
- ⟦{水道局|すいどうきょく}→水道局：27580_suidoukyoku⟧: water department/utility
- ⟦{水道管|すいどうかん}→水道管：08094_suidoukan⟧: water pipe
- ⟦{上水道|じょうすいどう}→上水道：16651_jousuidou⟧: water supply system
- ⟦{下水道|げすいどう}→下水道：09632_gesuidou⟧: sewage system

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan is known for having safe, drinkable tap water throughout the country. {水道|すいどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{飲|の}めます→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (tap water is drinkable) is commonly stated to reassure visitors.
